name: second-brain-backfill
title_zh: 多年书签和聊天记录，分批搬进第二大脑
tagline_zh: 攒了八年的书签、旧笔记导出、整个下载文件夹，一次性倒进 vault 只会淹掉它。
tagline_en: Eight years of bookmarks, an old notes export, a whole downloads folder — dumping them at once drowns your vault.
desc_en: Import a large archive into the vault in controlled batches: triage what is worth ingesting, process oldest first, checkpoint after every batch, and keep cost visible. Use this skill whenever the user wants to import years of bookmarks, an export from another notes app, a downloads folder, a chat history dump, or says "backfill", "bulk import", "process my archive". why_zh: 它把「导入」当成一条可中断的流水线：分诊、排序、批处理、存档点，四步各自独立。
why_en: It treats import as an interruptible pipeline: triage, ordering, batching, checkpoints — each independent, so a failed batch.
limit_zh: 只处理批量归档，单条笔记或单个链接的即时收藏它不管；分诊靠标题、URL 和摘要判断。
limit_en: Batch archives only — single notes or one-off clips are out of scope. Triage reads titles, URLs and snippets, so image- or attachment-only items get.
title_en: Backfill years of bookmarks into your vault in batches
